_meta: Single source of truth for per-program viewport/drawing colors (2026-07-28 consolidation pass). Previously duplicated by hand across three files that had to be kept in sync manually: frontend/src/components/Viewport.jsx (the original), drawing_styles.py (its own comment described itself as 'a duplicated source of truth, kept in sync manually'), and frontend/src/components/DiagnosticsPanel.jsx (a third copy added 2026-07-25 for the Program Distribution bars). Same consolidation, same reasoning, and same on-disk location as kindRegistry.json -- lives under frontend/src/ so Vite can import it as a build-time JSON asset; Python has no such restriction and just reads the file from disk. Keys are program_item LABELS (data/program_requirements.json's `label`), not ids, because that's what program-zone payloads carry through the pipeline.
_palette_rationale: Grouped by hue family per category (red/purple/indigo/teal = sports_recreation, blue/violet/cyan = enrichment_civic, greens = green_space/outdoor, pinks = health_care, slate/brown = support_amenity) so category identity still reads at a glance while each program within a category stays genuinely distinct. Deliberately avoids the orange/amber/beige family already load-bearing elsewhere in the viewport (ramp_slab #e8a23c, floor_slab #c9c2b3, amenity fixtures #ff8c26, salvage #8a8580) -- the old sports_recreation orange (#ff9800) was easy to mistake for ramp/slab geometry, which is the 'yellow slab' investigation this map was a direct answer to.
_fallback_rationale: fallback is used for any program_item not listed here (e.g. a data/program_requirements.json entry added later without a color picked yet) -- neutral grey, so it visually flags 'needs a color' rather than silently colliding with an existing category/kind color.
